_schema.name: Display name.
_schema.category: vegetable | fruit | protein | legume | grain | dairy | nut_seed | flavor | other
_schema.allergen: One of the common allergens, or null: peanut, egg, dairy, wheat, soy, sesame, tree_nut, fish, shellfish
_schema.bitter: Counts toward the bitter-flavor exposure goal.
_schema.sweet: Counts as a sweet fruit in the vegetable:fruit ratio.
_schema.min_age: Earliest age in months we will recommend it.
_schema.prep: Baby-led weaning prep, keyed by age band (6 = 6-8mo, 9 = 9-11mo, 12 = 12mo+).
_schema.note: Anything worth saying out loud, especially choking risk.
_schema.aliases: Alternate spellings seen in the sheet.
_schema.vitamin_c: 0 none, 1 moderate, 2 high. Eaten alongside plant iron it markedly increases absorption.
